The seven 'actions' below are the owner's own words and choices, unedited.
This is the only ground truth the project has. Do not 'improve' it to make

tt6.mp4 is ONE ~8.3s recording copied four times end to end. The labels
describe the source clip once; tools/score_run.py expands them x4 by adding
i * source_clip_duration_sec. So ground truth for the whole video is 28
actions, and the copy boundaries fall at about frames 249 / 498 / 747.
_known_limitations: action 'FOLD' is NOT in src/schema/event.py ActionType. The vocabulary has
no word for folding a box flap, which is a real gap for packing tasks, not
a labelling mistake. The scorer reports it as NOT_IN_VOCABULARY rather than
action 7 uses direction 'OFF' for lifting the box and moving it aside. The
template offered no value for a lateral move. That is a shortcoming of the
template, and 'OFF' is kept as written.
